newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tubacex sharply outperform Madrid bourse.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tubacex sharply outperform Madrid bourse.

text.p: Shares of Spain's Tubacex were sharply outperforming the Madrid bourse on Monday morning, amid heavy trading, while dealers said expectations of good economic results were supporting the shares.
"Shares (in Tubacex) are steady and this is due to fundamentals," said a trader at a Spanish saving bank.
At 1020 GMT, Tubacex was trading at 425 pesetas, 33 pesetas higher or 8.42 percent, sharply better than the 0.44 percent rise of the Ibex-35 at the same time.
Tubacex may also be supported by the decision, due later today, of the new list of companies forming the new basket of the blue chips index IBEX-35. Tubacex is considered a candidate, dealers said.
One week ago, during the shareholders meeting, Tubacex forecast 1997 consolidated net profit of 3.5 billion pesetas, which is 12 percent higher than in 1996.
Tubacex added that through May it had 1.77 billion pesetas net profit, 17.9 percent higher than the year-ago same period.
It also added that it would continue a policy of payback shareholders. It plans to reduce nominal value per share, now at 93 pesetas per share to 75 pesetas per share.
